title: Donor thank-you letters kit
summary: A collection of nouns and verbs for a small nonprofit's agent kit that drafts donor thank-you letters from a coded gift list with the finance lead's acknowledgment wording and checks donors' privacy choices first, while staff decide special handling and sign every letter.
boundaries: Use only made-up, clearly marked test data.
Steps marked for a person never go to an agent.
Outputs stay surface_only in the requester's scope.
Importing the pack writes nothing and enqueues nothing.

nouns.title: A collection of nouns and verbs for a donor thank-you letter agent kit with privacy checks

value.lets_workers: Check a coded gift list for each donor's anonymous, mail and listing choices, hold rows with a missing choice, and draft one thank-you letter per gift with merge fields for names and the finance lead's acknowledgment wording word for word. The development lead decides special handling, the finance lead confirms the wording, and staff sign every letter.
rules: Use only made-up, clearly marked test data. Never put a real person's details into the kit, a test case or an output.
Steps marked for a person stay with people. The agent drafts or helps; it never decides about a person and never contacts anyone.
Tools are read-only. Anything that changes records outside the requester's scope is a person's step.

provenance_notes.note: The marketplace's example of this kit. It holds only the catalog's own fields and points at this pack's kit and need nouns by value digest, so the kit has one source.

One recorded example run of the kit on a desktop computer with made-up data: check, build and independent review with the marketplace's own pipeline, zero model calls. Not a hosted run or an evaluation.

nouns.title: Donor Thank-You Letters with Privacy Checks Kit
nouns.category_reason: The agent's whole setup as one noun: its step map and pins to every part.

value.summary: Drafts thank-you letters from a coded gift list with the acknowledgment details the finance lead requires, and checks that no letter exposes another donor's details or ignores a privacy choice. Staff decide special handling and sign and send every letter.
value.goal: Help a small nonprofit draft personal thank-you letters from a coded gift list, include the gift acknowledgment details its finance lead requires, and check that no letter or list exposes another donor's information or ignores a donor's privacy choices, while the development lead decides special handling and staff sign and send every letter.
value.target_org: Small nonprofit thanking individual donors after a year-end appeal

step_map.title: Check the gift list against donors' privacy choices
step_map.guidance: Before drafting, check each coded gift row for its anonymous, mail and listing choices, and hold any row with a missing choice for the development lead.

step_map.title: Draft a thank-you letter for each gift
step_map.guidance: Draft one letter per cleared gift from the approved template with the gift date and amount, the finance lead's acknowledgment wording and a specific line about the program it supports. Names and addresses stay as merge fields.

step_map.title: Decide special handling for donors
step_map.guidance: The development lead decides personal calls, recognition, anonymity questions and any donor with a missing privacy choice. The agent only lists them.

step_map.title: Confirm the gift acknowledgment wording
step_map.guidance: The finance lead confirms the receipt wording, including any statement about goods or services given in return, against the organization's own rules and the IRS written acknowledgment requirements.

step_map.title: Sign and send each letter
step_map.guidance: Staff sign and send letters from the organization's own mail or email. The agent never sends letters or messages donors.

nouns.title: Skill: draft thank-you letters with merge fields

value.name: donor-letter-drafter
value.description: Drafts personal thank-you letters from a coded gift list, keeping names and addresses as merge fields.
value.instructions: Draft one letter per cleared gift row from the approved template. Keep names and addresses as merge fields that the organization's own mail merge fills at signing time, so no letter can carry another donor's details. Include the gift date, the amount and the acknowledgment wording the finance lead supplied, word for word. Add one specific sentence about the program the gift supports from the program notes. Skip any row the privacy check held or that is marked no mail, and list its code. Do not add tax advice.
refuses: Putting one donor's details in another donor's letter or in a shared list
Writing tax advice or changing the acknowledgment wording

nouns.title: Skill: check a coded gift list for privacy choices

value.name: gift-list-privacy-checker
value.description: Checks a coded gift list for missing privacy choices and rows that must not get a letter or a public listing.
value.instructions: Check that every row has an anonymous choice, a mail choice and a listing choice. Hold rows with a missing choice for the development lead, and rows with goods or services given in return for the finance lead. Mark anonymous donors so their names stay out of any public list or annual report draft. Report gift codes and counts by choice, never names.
refuses: Listing an anonymous donor in any public list
Reading or storing names and addresses

value.name: check_gift_list_privacy
value.description: Lists gift rows with missing privacy choices, rows marked no mail or anonymous, and rows with goods or services given in return.
